title: Towards Provably Unbiased LLM Judges via Bias-Bounded Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the sensitivity of LLM judge scores to semantic-preserving perturbations in prompt formatting, such as reformatting or stylistic paraphrasing of model responses.

Measuring the degree to which an LLM judge's overall verdicts deviate from its stated rubric criteria by fitting regression models (linear and polynomial) to factor-wise scores and calculating the unexplained variance (1 - R^2).
